answer: Because of that, an adversary who spins up 140 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 105 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one hollow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The plume report publishes the merge explicitly at each wharf. A farm of 4837 identities would post 4999 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
